objective: Build a bounded doubling schedule while distinguishing a readonly type view from runtime immutability and later-call stability.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Doubling bounds and readonly result types remain current language concepts.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: A computed retry schedule is a practical preparatory helper.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Monotonic loops, boundary inclusion and output lifetime transfer to other sequence builders.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Finite integer bounds isolate the while/readonly lesson without actual asynchronous requests.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Prevents basic nontermination and shared-array mistakes, rather than specifying production retry policy.

defects: Finite bounds, cap interpretation and output lifetime across calls were unstated.
Senior used a for-loop despite the requested while teaching approach.
The readonly sentence needed to distinguish checked access from runtime freezing.
rationale: Retain correct reference/junior and align the senior to while plus its optional runtime freeze. Keep the original for/freeze board as an accepted alternative. Define finite integer first/cap within±1e9, nonpositive first/over-cap empty behavior, exact equality inclusion and schedules unaffected by later calls. Do not demand every call have a distinct reference if immutable cached results would satisfy the contract. Cases retain multiple outputs across calls, check all30 powers through cap1e9 and negative/equality/over-cap boundaries. Target logarithmic output/time uses2+max(0,cap) as a magnitude. The shared mutable-output wrong was already caught by the original runner batch; no new false-pass claim is made for it.

objective: Toggle exact Set membership in a fresh mutable copy while retaining insertion order and caller state.

relevanceRationale.audienceFit: One copy plus add/delete is a focused foundational operation.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Sorting or mutating a caller collection can change selection behavior and rendered order.

defects: ReadonlySet wording could imply its runtime methods disappear.
Insertion order, fresh independent output and bounded exact strings were incomplete.

Cases inspect unsorted/space/case IDs, independence after mutating one result and1000 preserved entries with an appended value. A filter/copy alternative passes. Target linear copy/output under average constant-time Set operations; no sorting is needed.
